mapper.select: SELECT kt.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , kt.TR_YMD AS tr_ymd , kt.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , kt.TR_CD AS tr_cd , kt.SJ_CD AS sj_cd , kj.SJ_NM AS xx_sj_cd , kj.SJ_NM AS sj_nm , kt.CHASU AS chasu , kt.TR_SEQ_NO AS tr_seq_no , kt.GYEY_SU AS gyey_su , kt.GYEY_JISU AS gyey_jisu , kt.TR_CO_CD AS tr_co_cd , NVL(kj.UNIT_AEK, 1) AS xx_unit_aek , NVL(kj.UNIT_AEK, 1) AS unit_aek , kt.SUSU_TR_CO_CD AS susu_tr_co_cd , m2.TR_CO_NM AS xx_susu_tr_co_cd , m2.TR_CO_NM AS susu_tr_co_nm , kt.GYEY_AEK AS gyey_aek , ROUND(kt.GYEY_SU * kt.GYEY_JISU * NVL(kj.UNIT_AEK, 1)) AS yakjung_aek , kt.GYEY_AEK - ROUND(kt.GYEY_SU * kt.GYEY_JISU * NVL(kj.UNIT_AEK, 1)) AS cha_aek , 1 AS p_visible FROM SST1KT kt LEFT OUTER JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = kt.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = kt.FUND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN SSX0KJ kj ON kj.CORP_GR = kt.CORP_GR AND kj.SJ_CD = kt.SJ_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX2MM m2 ON m2.CORP_GR = kt.CORP_GR AND m2.TR_CO_CD = kt.SUSU_TR_CO_CD WHERE kt.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND kt.TR_YMD = #{trYmd} AND kt.TR_CD = #{trCd} ORDER BY kt.SJ_CD, kt.FUND_CD
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd FROM SST1KT t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_CD IN ( SELECT ta.TR_CD FROM SZX1PT ta WHERE ta.OBJ_ID = 'W_JA031A' ) ORDER BY tr_ymd
